$comment: POLICY: stricter than Claude Code. Every object closes its keys (additionalProperties or unevaluatedProperties false), because this repository authors these files and a typo the CLI silently ignores is a bug. x-cli-unknown-keys records, measured on 2.1.310, what the CLI does with an unknown key in that object: rejects (error, the component fails to load), warns (warning; claude plugin validate --strict fails) or ignores (no message). Fields the CLI accepts but the docs do not name carry x-docs-status (cli-tolerated, cli-only, changelog-only). Entries reuse plugin.schema.json#/$defs/manifest. Built from the official Claude Code docs (plugin-marketplaces, plugins-reference, plugin-dependencies, plugin-relevance, hooks, mcp) and verified against `claude plugin validate --strict` 2.1.281 on 2026-09-24. Not the SchemaStore schema: fields are docs-derived; undocumented-but-accepted fields carry x-undocumented. additionalProperties:false is used where the CLI warns on unknown keys (root, metadata, plugin entries, relevance, experimental, userConfig options, LSP servers, monitors, channels) and true where it accepts them silently (owner, author, source objects, dependency objects, hook handlers, MCP server configs). Not expressible in JSON Schema and left to the CLI: unique plugin names, renames chain resolution, entry.version vs plugin.json cross-check, existence of source directories, name impersonation heuristics, unique monitor names, options default membership, sha256 of archives.
title: Claude Code plugin marketplace (.claude-plugin/marketplace.json)
description: Catalog of plugins that Claude Code can install with /plugin install <plugin>@<marketplace>. Lives at .claude-plugin/marketplace.json in the marketplace repository root, or is served as a direct URL to the file.

$schema.description: JSON Schema URL for editor autocomplete; Claude Code ignores it at load time.

name.description: Marketplace identifier (kebab-case recommended). Public-facing: /plugin install <plugin>@<name>. One marketplace per name per user. npm, pip, uv, cargo, github, gh (any casing) are hard errors in `claude plugin validate`. A name that impersonates an official marketplace (heuristic; the docs give official-claude-plugins and anthropic-plugins-v2 as examples) is a hard error too. The 17 names in x-reserved-official-names are reserved for Anthropic per the docs, but `claude plugin validate` 2.1.281 does NOT reject them (oracle-verified: n00-n04, n30-n32, im03/09/11/19/21/25 all pass validate unchanged) — enforcement happens only when the marketplace is actually registered (`/plugin marketplace add`), which this schema cannot exercise offline. Likewise 'org', 'org-provisioned' and 'unknown' are only a Claude-Desktop-sync warning, not a validate error.
name.x-not-enforced-by: claude plugin validate 2.1.281 (offline); docs say Claude Code re-checks reserved names on every marketplace load

owner.description: Marketplace maintainer information (unknown keys are accepted silently by the CLI).

name.description: Name of the maintainer or team.

url.description: Website, GitHub profile or organization URL.

plugins.description: List of available plugins. Plugin names must be unique (case-sensitive) within the marketplace. An empty list is a validator warning.

description.description: Brief marketplace description (also accepted under metadata for backward compatibility). Missing description is a validator warning.

version.description: Marketplace manifest version (also accepted under metadata for backward compatibility).

metadata.description: Optional marketplace metadata. Unknown keys are validator warnings.

pluginRoot.description: Directory that bare plugin source names resolve under (v2.1.239+). Must itself be a relative path inside the marketplace.

description.description: Marketplace description (backward-compatible spelling of the top-level field).

version.description: Marketplace version (backward-compatible spelling of the top-level field).

allowCrossMarketplaceDependenciesOn.description: Other marketplaces that plugins in this marketplace may depend on; dependencies from an unlisted marketplace are blocked at install. Only the root marketplace's list is consulted (no transitive trust).

renames.description: Map from a former plugin name to its current name, or to null if the plugin was removed (v2.1.193+). Treat as append-only history; chains are followed. Every chain must end at null or a name listed in plugins (cycles and dangling targets are errors; not expressible in JSON Schema).

forceRemoveDeletedPlugins.description: When true, plugins removed from this marketplace are automatically uninstalled and flagged for users.
forceRemoveDeletedPlugins.x-note: In the SchemaStore baseline; accepted by CLI 2.1.281 without warning; the binary references it in delisted-plugin enforcement. Absent from every current docs page and the changelog.

metadata.description: Constraint fragment used by a conditional rule; see the enclosing definition.

source.description: Constraint fragment used by a conditional rule; see the enclosing definition.

plugins.description: Constraint fragment used by a conditional rule; see the enclosing definition.

pluginName.description: Plugin or marketplace identifier. Documented as kebab-case with no spaces, control characters or bidirectional-formatting characters. This pattern is the documented Claude Desktop accepted set (letters, digits, '.', '_', '-'; starts alphanumeric; max 128), a superset of kebab-case. Claude Code itself only hard-rejects spaces and control/bidi characters; other forms are validator warnings.

sourceRelativePath.description: Relative path source: a local directory inside the marketplace repository. Must start with './' (or be '.' / './' for the marketplace root), is resolved from the marketplace root (the directory containing .claude-plugin/), must not contain '..' segments or backslashes. Not usable when the marketplace is added by a direct URL to marketplace.json.

sourceBareName.description: Bare directory name (no '/'), resolved under metadata.pluginRoot. Only valid when the marketplace sets metadata.pluginRoot (v2.1.239+). Organization sync rejects bare names.

repo.description: GitHub repository in owner/repo format (a single repository; owner wildcards are only valid in managed settings). The CLI does not enforce the owner/repo shape or non-emptiness (oracle: a bare name, a full https URL, and an empty string all pass `claude plugin validate`); the pattern below documents the intended format only and is informational, not enforced by this schema.

ref.description: Git branch or tag to use. Defaults to the repository default branch. The CLI accepts an empty string too.

sha.description: Full 40-character git commit SHA pinning an exact version. When both ref and sha are set, sha is the effective pin. Docs say '40-character'; the CLI additionally requires lowercase hex.

url.description: Full git repository URL (https:// or git@). The .git suffix is optional. The CLI accepts an empty string too.

ref.description: Git branch or tag to use. Defaults to the repository default branch. The CLI accepts an empty string too.

sha.description: Full 40-character git commit SHA pinning an exact version. When both ref and sha are set, sha is the effective pin. Docs say '40-character'; the CLI additionally requires lowercase hex.

sourceGitSubdir.description: Plugin located in a subdirectory of a git repository (sparse partial clone).

url.description: Git repository URL, GitHub owner/repo shorthand, or SSH URL. The CLI accepts an empty string too.

path.description: Subdirectory path within the repo that contains the plugin, for example tools/claude-plugin. Cloned sparsely.

ref.description: Git branch or tag to use. Defaults to the repository default branch. The CLI accepts an empty string too.

sha.description: Full 40-character git commit SHA pinning an exact version. When both ref and sha are set, sha is the effective pin. Docs say '40-character'; the CLI additionally requires lowercase hex.

sourceNpm.description: npm package source; fetched with npm pack --ignore-scripts and unpacked without running install scripts.

package.description: Package name or scoped package, for example @org/plugin. The CLI accepts an empty string too.

version.description: Version or version range, for example 2.1.0, ^2.0.0 or ~1.5.0.

registry.description: Custom npm registry URL (http or https). Defaults to the system npm registry.

sourceArchive.description: Zip archive source downloaded over HTTPS (requires Claude Code v2.1.224+).

url.description: HTTPS URL of the zip archive. http:// and loopback, link-local and cloud-metadata hosts are refused (the host check in this schema is a best-effort approximation), as is every redirect hop that breaks the rules. Max 256 MiB.

sha256.description: SHA-256 digest of the archive as 64 hex characters (either case). Verified on every download; doubles as the plugin version when no version is declared.

sourceCommand.description: Command source: a local command produces the plugin directory (requires Claude Code v2.1.229+; can be disabled by managed setting disableCommandPluginSources).

command.description: Shell command that prints the absolute path of the plugin directory as a single stdout line and exits 0. Printable ASCII, at most 500 characters, no runs of four or more spaces.

timeout.description: Whole seconds to wait for the command (default 60, maximum 600).

mode.description: copy (default) copies the printed directory into the plugin cache; link uses it in place (not supported on Windows).

pluginSource.description: Where to fetch the plugin from: a relative path string, a bare directory name (with metadata.pluginRoot), or one of the source objects github, url, git-subdir, npm, archive, command (discriminated by the 'source' key). There is no pip, zip or generic 'git' plugin source in the docs; the CLI rejects them.

relevance.description: Signals telling Claude Code when to suggest this plugin. Only takes effect for marketplaces an administrator allowlists in managed settings (pluginSuggestionMarketplaces). Unknown keys are validator warnings.

topic.description: Phrase for 'Working with <topic>?' in the spinner tip; defaults to the capitalized plugin name. Max 64 characters.

signals.description: Matchers that decide when the plugin is relevant. At least one non-empty signal is required.

cwd.description: Working-directory globs; the only signal that can match at session start. Max 10 patterns of 256 chars.

items.description: Glob matched against the session working directory (absolute and, in a git repo, repo-relative), forward slashes, case-insensitive.

cli.description: Command names Claude has run in shell commands this session. Max 10 entries of 64 chars.

hosts.description: Hostnames seen in http(s) URLs in Bash commands. Max 20 entries of 128 chars.

items.description: Lowercase bare hostname: no scheme, port or path.

filesRead.description: File-read globs. Max 10 patterns of 256 chars.

items.description: Glob matched against paths of files Claude has read (forward slashes, case-insensitive).

manifestDeps.description: Dependencies declared in package manifests Claude has read. Max 10 entries.

file.description: JavaScript RegExp source matched (case-insensitively) against the manifest file path; anchor at the end.

pattern.description: JavaScript RegExp source matched (case-sensitively) against the manifest file contents.

relevance.x-cli-measured: 2.1.310: relevance without signals is an error; signals with none set is an error

pluginEntry.description: A plugin listed in the marketplace. Beyond the marketplace-specific fields (source, category, tags, strict, relevance, headers, headersHelper) an entry may carry any field of the plugin manifest schema. Unknown fields are validator warnings (errors under --strict).

name.description: Plugin identifier (kebab-case recommended); users see it in /plugin install <name>@<marketplace>. Must be unique in the marketplace.

source.description: Where to fetch the plugin from: a relative path string, a bare directory name (with metadata.pluginRoot), or one of the source objects github, url, git-subdir, npm, archive, command (discriminated by the 'source' key). There is no pip, zip or generic 'git' plugin source in the docs; the CLI rejects them.

strict.description: Whether plugin.json is the authority for component definitions (default true: entry supplements plugin.json and both merge; false: the entry is the entire definition and a plugin.json that also declares components is a conflict).

relevance.description: Signals telling Claude Code when to suggest this plugin. Only takes effect for marketplaces an administrator allowlists in managed settings (pluginSuggestionMarketplaces). Unknown keys are validator warnings.

headers.description: HTTP headers sent when downloading this entry's archive; overrides same-named marketplace headers (v2.1.238+). Only meaningful for archive sources.

headersHelper.description: Command that prints the archive-download headers as one JSON object, for short-lived credentials. Printable ASCII, max 500 characters, no runs of four or more spaces. The entry must set strict: false (v2.1.238+). Only meaningful for archive sources.

hooks.description: Entry hooks load only as an inline event map: a file path or an array passes claude plugin validate but never runs, with a `not yet supported in a marketplace entry` error.

allOf.description: headersHelper requires strict: false (error in the CLI).
headers/headersHelper only apply to archive sources (validator warning otherwise).

pluginEntry.x-cli-unknown-keys: warns (directory listing fields such as icon also warn here)
